title: Study via Approximate Symmetries of the Emergence of Secondary Flux in the Bevilacqua-Galeão Model
summary: The Bevilacqua-Galeão Model of Anomalous Diffusion introduces two fluxes: a primary flux that follows Fick's law of diffusion, representing the fraction of particles undergoing classical diffusion, and a secondary flux modeled by a fourth-order differential term, which accounts for retention phenomena. We investigate the ``analytic emergence'' of this secondary flux by treating the model as a (singular) perturbation of the heat equation, which describes the classical diffusion.
